scope: Independent read-only source review of four accepted controlled-BUCK findings. Final runtime pipeline results are recorded separately by the owner; this receipt does not claim native-board or physical regulator qualification.
result: No remaining source-level blocker in the four reviewed fixes.

findings.result: Closed at standalone/Wasm/World setup and authoritative CPU advance; chips without declared stages retain legacy empty-model behavior.
Every generated primitive prefix is reserved against routed source and thermistor targets after trimming and case folding; complete field/model owner and physical domain-node checks remain strict.

Standalone stores an interval-start command frame; independent halfway and faster-unrelated-model regressions require revision 0 at T and revision 1 at 2T. World explicitly samples before its interval. Observation batches validate before publication.

Public operating-point solve and each accepted nonlinear step validate finite signed SW/input/quiescent quantities. Reverse current and reverse power outside explicit 1 pA/1 pW residual tolerances fail before time/index acceptance. Direct Solver transient and OP regressions cover the placement.

adjacent_review: HIZ omits controlled output resistance, input power sink and quiescent stamps without resetting external capacitor/inductor histories.
Controlled BUCK is always nonlinear through its power sink, so the linear settled early-return path cannot bypass the guard.
Rated-load trace follows the applied command frame and remains distinct from actual supply-envelope qualification; it is not a load injection or a new protection output.
